detail.text: Stop the goods receipt process immediately when the WMS shows an error code not listed in GUIDE-WMS-003.
Do not bypass the WMS error by posting the goods receipt against a different purchase order line.

Contact the WMS key user to resolve the unlisted error code GR-299.
Escalate to the WMS key user if the error code GR-299 is not resolved within 1 hour.
